ClientCapabilities.description:
What a connected client can render and accept.

All flags default to `false`: a client only gets richer projections after it explicitly opts in, so an unknown or minimal client is always served the safe, plain-text baseline.

analytics.description: Can query measured usage and consume bounded exports.

automation.description: Can manage trigger and schedule automation bindings.

bundles.description: Can export and import versioned redacted bundles.

diff_view.description: Can render a side-by-side or unified diff.

editor_actions.description: Can invoke ordinary runs from editor-native actions.

editor_mutations.description: Owns an editor buffer the daemon may mutate semantically.

inbox.description: Can render and mutate the durable owner-scoped inbox.

marketplace.description: Can manage marketplace packages and publisher trust.

mouse.description: Reports mouse input (every mouse affordance also has a keyboard path).

rich_text.description: Renders styled text (bold, colour spans, links).

session_library.description: Can browse and navigate the cursor-paged Session Library.

description: The client's opening message: who it is, what it speaks, and what it can do.

resume_token.description: Present when resuming a prior connection.

supported_protocols.description: Protocol versions the client can speak, best first.
